🎬 House M.D. (2004–2012)

House M.D. follows Dr. Gregory House, a brilliant but deeply unconventional medical genius working at Princeton-Plainsboro Teaching Hospital in New Jersey, where he leads a team of specialists dedicated to solving the most mysterious and complicated medical cases. Known for his extraordinary intelligence, sarcastic personality, and complete disregard for traditional rules, House frequently clashes with hospital administrators, colleagues, and patients while attempting to uncover illnesses that other doctors cannot diagnose. Despite suffering from chronic leg pain and struggling with prescription painkiller dependence, his remarkable diagnostic abilities make him one of the hospital’s most valuable physicians. Alongside his team, House investigates unusual symptoms, life-threatening conditions, and shocking medical mysteries that require creative thinking and difficult ethical decisions. From tense hospital confrontations and unexpected patient revelations to complicated friendships, romantic struggles, and deeply personal challenges, House constantly pushes the boundaries of medicine and human relationships. His close friendship with Dr. James Wilson and frequent disagreements with hospital administrator Dr. Lisa Cuddy reveal the complicated emotions beneath his cynical personality. Combining gripping medical mysteries, sharp humor, emotional drama, and unforgettable characters, the series explores truth, morality, addiction, friendship, and the extraordinary complexity of the human mind.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Mystery • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 42–44 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: David Shore
